description: This file defines a RecyclerView.ViewHolder subclass for displaying internal share links within an Android application's user interface, specifically for a notes app integrated with Nextcloud. It includes view binding and interaction logic for share items.

classes.name: InternalShareViewHolder
classes.description: A RecyclerView ViewHolder for displaying internal share links, handling UI text updates based on share type and user interaction via clicking the copy container.

methods.name: InternalShareViewHolder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ViewHolder with view binding and context.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Bind share data to the view, setting the appropriate text and setting up click listener for copying the link.
